items.h: It takes 21 days to build a habit.
items.b: It often takes around two months, and it varies a lot. Don't quit on day 22.
One missed day barely changes the long-term curve. Missing two in a row is what kills habits.
You need a smaller first step. Two minutes is enough to start.
Tracking is how you see progress you'd otherwise forget.
